args.title: Reject non-integer token lifetime settings with units
args.body:
File: src/config.ts

The token lifetime environment variable TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES is currently parsed as an integer without rejecting values with units like '12h'. This causes incorrect token expiry handling when such values are used. Change the parsing to validate input strictly as an integer and reject invalid formats. This prevents silent acceptance of wrong values such as '12h' which lead to shorter token life than intended.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The health check endpoint `/api/v1/health` returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body containing status and checks. When the status is "degraded", the HTTP status remains 200, but the JSON flags suboptimal conditions like queue depth. This means the instance is technically healthy but signals degraded performance. You may choose to treat it as healthy or not based on your own load balancer's criteria.

args.title: Fix locale selection to respect Accept-Language q weights
args.body:
File: src/i18n/index.ts

The pickLocale function currently selects the first supported locale seen in the Accept-Language header ignoring the quality (q) values which indicate weight of preference. Change the function to parse and respect q values to pick the language with highest weight, so a header such as `en;q=0.3, fr-FR;q=0.9` correctly picks French instead of English.

label: bug
file: src/i18n/index.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The locale selection ignores the q weights in the Accept-Language header and simply picks the first supported language. This causes French with a higher q value to be ignored in favor of English first in the list. The fix is to parse and respect q values and choose the locale with the highest weight.
